## First Horizon Bank Celebrates Grand Opening of Charlotte Corporate Office at 110 East


November 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/903615748/files/doc_news/First-Horizon-Bank-Celebrates-Grand-Opening-of-Charlotte-Corporate-Office-at-110-East-2026.pdf)


CHARLOTTE, N.C.


, Nov. 19, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") is proud to announce the official grand opening of its Charlotte corporate office at 110 East Boulevard. Centrally located in the Queen City's popular South End neighborhood, the office is positioned for the team to build and strengthen relationships with clients across the Charlotte area, and it enables First Horizon to serve the community as the company continues to expand its footprint across the region.


First Horizon is the anchor tenant at 110 East, a 24-story tower located in the city's East Boulevard corridor. Prominent First Horizon signage placement on the north and south sides of the building not only enhance the city's skyline, they signal the bank's commitment to the Charlotte community.


"We plan to be in Charlotte for the long term, and this office is a visible sign of that. Our name on the Charlotte skyline says we intend to keep earning the trust of the people and businesses we serve here," said Bryan Jordan, Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer of First Horizon.


"Charlotte is the epicenter of our Mid-Atlantic region, and our clients expect us to show up with the same energy and ambition they bring to their own work," said Laura Bunn, Executive Vice President and Mid-Atlantic Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "110 East provides an ideal location to meet people and businesses where they are, from Uptown to the city's surrounding communities."


First Horizon will host various events throughout the year and support community involvement efforts that enhance the places where clients and associates work, live and serve.


For more information on First Horizon Bank and the Charlotte team, visit[www.firsthorizon.com](https://www.firsthorizon.com/Bank/NC/Banking-in-Charlotte) .


**About First Horizon** First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN), with $84.3 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026, is a leading regional financial services company, dedicated to helping our clients, communities and associates unlock their full potential with capital and counsel. Headquartered in Memphis, TN, the banking subsidiary First Horizon Bank operates in 12 states concentrated in the southern U.S. The Company and its subsidiaries offer commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services. First Horizon has been recognized as one of the nation's best employers by Fortune and Forbes magazines and a Top 10 Most Reputable U.S. Bank. More information is available at[www.FirstHorizon.com](https://www.firsthorizon.com/) .
